propositions: Rebar lacks a native Bedrock provider path; clients currently rely on an OpenAI-compatible gateway (PR #121) that sacrifices prompt caching and structured output
Prompt caching on Bedrock is model-dependent and fails silently—when both cache_read and cache_write tokens are zero, operators pay full input cost every call with no warning

Some Bedrock models reject the temperature parameter with a 400 ValidationException, hard-failing rebar's Pass-2 verify steps that deliberately set temperature=0 for greedy determinism; the direct-Anthropic path degrades gracefully but Bedrock has no mitigation

The existing _warn_if_zeroed_usage predicate cannot detect silent cache failures because it fires only when input_tokens==0, whereas cache failure shows input_tokens>0 with both cache counters at zero
Decision A: us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 (a regional inference profile) is the verified-caching default; plain on-demand model ids are not invokable in the measured environment

Decision C requires a second per-model-id capability override table to withdraw supports_temperature without blanket-stripping it from all Bedrock Claude models, preserving Pass-2 determinism on measured-good defaults
